purpose: Design document for the start-plan workflow that derives an implementation strategy from design documents, extracts tasks, creates a plan, and passes AI and human review, including the plan-strategist agent exchange.
summary: Overview of the start-plan orchestrator flow from document gathering to strategy, plan creation and review
Delegation to agents: general-purpose gathering, custom plan-strategist agent, and review
Agent data exchange contract: identifiers, request JSON, strategy document, completion value and cleanup
strategy_exchange script subcommands open, request-path, finish and check
Flowchart including strategy approval loop and failure handling
Preparation and Phase 1 context collection with design documents required and requirements optional
Phase 2 document reading and Phase 3 strategy creation, including diff-development handling
Phase 4 plan creation with task granularity, required_reading rules and completeness checks
Phase 5 review, completion steps, design principles and related files
tasks: Modifying the start-plan skill or its workflow
Changing the plan-strategist agent or strategy_exchange script
Creating or updating a plan document from design documents
Defining task granularity and traceability in plans
